name: Zhejiang Huayuan Auto Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Huayuan Auto Technology Co., Ltd. researches, develops, produces, and sells automotive system connectors in China and internationally. It offers special-shaped fasteners, seat locks, automotive seats and sensors, energy vehicle battery packs, and others. The company's products are used in automobile chassis and powertrain, safety, intelligent electronic, and interior and exterior systems. It also exports its products. The company was founded in 2002 and is based in Wenzhou, China. Zhejiang Huayuan Auto Technology Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Wenzhou Chenxi Investment Management Partnership (Limited Partnership).
